findings.title: An optional hook whose launcher fails is exempted from escalation but never recorded in `optional_hooks_died`, so `drive_hook_gate` defers the guarded step every pass forever with no boundary
`jobs gc --reap-prepared` parses `--prepared-older-than-s` but ignores it, silently applying `--older-than-s`/3600 instead — the same "typed a bound, got another" shape F41 reports
The F41 "died without an envelope" half is pinned by a test that is already green on the base commit (a tripwire), so the required RED case for that shape is not delivered
